instruction: Repo: Go project at /echo (labstack/echo v4). Task: fix a bug in /echo/context.go, function `func (c *context) Scheme() string` (around line 252). Current code returns whatever value is in the X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Protocol / X-Url-Scheme headers without validating it. Expected behaviour (hidden tests): invalid header values must be ignored: e.g. an invalid X-Forwarded-Proto must be ignored so that X-Forwarded-Protocol is used instead; if all forwarded headers are invalid the result must be "http". Implement: only accept a forwarded header value if it equals "http" or "https" (compare case-insensitively with strings.EqualFold and return the lower-cased value); keep the order of checks: TLS -> https; X-Forwarded-Proto; X-Forwarded-Protocol; X-Forwarded-Ssl == "on" (case-insensitive) -> https; X-Url-Scheme; else "http". Do not change anything else. Constraints: do NOT edit any *_test.go file, and do not break existing tests (existing TestContext_Scheme cases must still pass: X-Forwarded-Proto https -> https, X-Forwarded-Protocol http -> http, X-Forwarded-Ssl on -> https, X-Url-Scheme https -> https, no headers -> http). Verify with: `cd /echo && go test -run 'TestContext' -v .` and `cd /echo && go test ./...`. Report the final Scheme() code, the commands run and their results.

Repo: Go project at /echo (labstack/echo v4). Task: fix a bug in /echo/middleware/proxy.go. Bug: when a ProxyBalancer has no targets, the middleware panics: randomBalancer.Next calls rand.Intn(0) (panics) and roundRobinBalancer.Next computes b.i % uint32(len(b.targets)) (divide by zero panic); the middleware then also dereferences a nil target. Expected behaviour: with a balancer that has no targets the middleware must NOT panic and must respond with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable. Implement exactly: (1) in randomBalancer.Next, after acquiring b.mutex.RLock()/defer RUnlock, add `if len(b.targets) == 0 { return nil }` before indexing; (2) in roundRobinBalancer.Next, take b.mutex.RLock()/defer b.mutex.RUnlock(), add `if len(b.targets) == 0 { return nil }`, then keep the existing modulo/index/atomic logic; (3) in ProxyWithConfig's returned handler, right after `tgt := config.Balancer.Next(c)` add `if tgt == nil { return echo.ErrServiceUnavailable }` before `c.Set(config.ContextKey, tgt)`. Change nothing else in the file. Verify: create a temporary test file /echo/middleware/zz_tmp_notargets_test.go (package middleware) with a test that for both NewRandomBalancer(nil) and NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil) does: e := echo.New(); e.Use(Proxy(bal)); req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil); rec := httptest.NewRecorder(); e.ServeHTTP(rec, req); require 503. Run `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ -run 'TestProxy' -v` and `cd /echo && go test ./...`. Then DELETE the temporary test file (leave no new test files). Report: the final content of the changed hunks of proxy.go, exact commands run, and their results.

Repo: Go project at /echo (labstack/echo v4), package middleware, file /echo/middleware/compress.go. There is exactly one injected bug in compress.go. (4) Fix the bug minimally in /echo/middleware/compress.go only - never edit *_test.go files, and make sure a normal non-empty gzip response still works and existing tests still pass.
